text: As the others say, there is a possibility that she will get the B1 visa on the spot after the interview - just remember to ask for an intervisa and then you will be fine. If they delay the decision to give the B1 visa (which sometimes happens), it depends on your girlfriend's current visa, whether she has an intervisa, and whether they expire after the trip. If she doesn't have these, you will need to ask that they extend her current visa and request an intervisa for that - it will cost around 400 NIS. As long as there is a valid intervisa, there should not be problems returning.
